note.label: Another language
note.text: Not a Massachusett word but an English label for the people.
note.compare: Wood's own ethnonym 'Aberginians'; Massachusett 'person/Indian' = wosketomp / ninnimissinnuwok

entries.gloss: when I see it I will tell you my minde
much good may your meate doe you

note.label: Phrase taken for a word
note.text: Speaker answered 'you' when collector pointed to himself.
note.compare: Massachusett ken/keen 'you (sg.)', neen 'I'; Wood himself uses kean = 'you' in n=18,19,228

entries.gloss: give me a span of any thing.
a man of a middle stature
give me a pipe of Tobaco

note.label: Loanword
note.text: Sagamore is the northern (Abenaki) form, spread to English via the coastal trade; the local form is sachem.
note.compare: Eastern Abenaki sakəma, Mi'kmaq saqamaw 'chief'; Massachusett cognate is sachem/sontim (n=183)
